un-ga-res-a-69-5: Resolution A/69/5, adopted in 2014 during the 69th session. The early acts of the session. The designation and year align; the subject belongs to the text.
life-of-george-washington-volume-1-of-5: Washington Irving opens his monumental life of Washington with the hero's Virginia youth, his early military service, and the making of a leader. The beloved storyteller brings his grace and warmth to the founding father's story. This first of five volumes begins an enduring American classic.
the-great-conspiracy-volume-5: The fifth volume covers 1864 — Grant in Virginia, Sherman in Georgia, and the grinding road to victory. Logan's account captures the war's terrible cost and high purpose. History written by a man who lived it. The Wilderness, Spotsylvania, and the long siege lines come alive in his detailed, devoted account.
the-prince-and-the-pauper-part-5: Edward's wanderings with Miles Hendon continue through a England both cruel and kind. Their friendship deepens amid danger. Twain's heart is fully in this part of the tale. Hendon's battered honor shines all the brighter beside the boy king's peril.
the-adventures-of-tom-sawyer-part-5: Lost in the cave with Becky, Tom faces his greatest test in this fifth part. Darkness, bats, and Injun Joe's lurking presence build unbearable tension. The cave chapters are among Twain's finest. Kite string and courage guide them through the dark toward daylight.
a-connecticut-yankee-in-king-arthur-s-co: The fifth part follows Hank's travels with the king incognito — Sandy, the smallpox hut, and Morgan le Fay's castle. Adventure and satire ride together. Twain's England, seen with biting clarity. Pigsties and princesses, slavery and chivalry pass before his Yankee eyes.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-5: This 2007 GAO report digs into how Social Security pays the helpers who guide injury-benefit claims. New fee rules looked hopeful, GAO found, but who may serve and who got overpaid still needed a closer watch. The report shines a light on a back-office corner where sloppy math can shortchange claimants and cost the public real money.
gao-gaoreports-b-299145-5: Aerospace royalty went to war at GAO in August 2007 — Lockheed Martin versus Sikorsky, two case numbers, one giant prize. The combined ruling untangles the dueling protests over a major aviation deal. When helicopter legends clash, the referee's call echoes through the industry.
